text: Understanding Git branching is an important skill for developers. A branch lets you work on new features without affecting the main code. When you start a new task, you create a feature branch from the main branch. This keeps your changes separate and safe. After you finish your work, you merge the branch back into the main one. Many teams use pull requests to review code before merging. This makes the version control workflow clearer and helps teams avoid mistakes. By using branches, developers can work together more easily and keep the project organized.
